theme_and_archetype.rationale: For an industrial Enterprise SaaS / Warehouse Management System (WMS), a dark 'command center' layout improves contrast for dense data. We use Deep Obsidian as a base, with Signal Amber/Yellow accents to mimic safety gear and industrial equipment. This prevents the 'fintech bro' generic purple look and establishes a tactical, high-performance atmosphere.

typography.rules: Never use Inter or Roboto. Use Monospace (JetBrains Mono) for ALL numerical data, SKUs, inventory counts, and coordinates. Use tight tracking for headings.

spacing_and_layout.gaps: gap-4 or gap-6 for tight, data-dense packing
spacing_and_layout.padding: p-4 or p-6 for cards; py-8 for main sections
rules: Sidebar should be fixed width (w-64) on desktop, hidden on mobile with hamburger.
Use 'border-collapse' style or 1px grid borders (border-white/10) to expose the technical skeleton.

component_styles.cards: bg-[#181A20] border border-white/10 rounded-sm shadow-none. For hover interactions: hover:border-amber-500/50 transition-colors duration-200.

buttons.primary: bg-amber-500 text-black hover:bg-amber-600 font-semibold rounded-sm px-4 py-2 uppercase tracking-wide text-sm
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-white/20 text-white hover:bg-white/5 rounded-sm px-4 py-2 text-sm

component_styles.inputs: bg-[#090A0C] border border-white/10 rounded-sm px-3 py-2 text-white focus:border-amber-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-amber-500 font-mono text-sm
component_styles.tables: w-full border-collapse text-left text-sm. Headers: bg-[#111317] uppercase text-xs tracking-wider text-gray-500 py-3 px-4. Cells: border-b border-white/5 py-3 px-4. Hover: hover:bg-white/5.
component_styles.badges: px-2 py-1 text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider font-bold rounded-sm border
component_styles.charts: Use Recharts. Line/Bar charts should use Amber (#F59E0B), Emerald (#10B981) and Red (#EF4444) for data lines. Hide generic grid lines or make them very faint (rgba(255,255,255,0.05)).

authentication.layout: Split screen. Left: Dark industrial abstract image/pattern with a glowing amber overlay. Right: Login form in deep obsidian (#090A0C).
authentication.elements: Role selector (Admin, Manager, Operator) using segmented control or stylized radio buttons. Large, blocky 'LOGIN' CTA.

dashboard.layout: Top row: 4 KPI metric cards (Total SKUs, Stock Value, Low Stock Alerts, Today's In/Out). Middle row: Wide Chart (Stock Movement) spanning 2/3, Activity Feed spanning 1/3.
dashboard.kpi_cards: Must include mono-spaced big numbers, a subtle icon (Phosphor icons), and a colored trend indicator (+/- %).

inventory_master.layout: Full-width data table. Top bar with Search input (mono-font) and 'Add SKU' CTA.
inventory_master.special_features: Include a column for 'Barcode'. Render simulated barcode lines using a dedicated font or raw SVG styling (or just display a barcode icon next to the mono-spaced SKU text). Status badge for 'In Stock', 'Low Stock', 'Out of Stock'.

inbound_outbound.layout: Split-pane or Kanban-style for moving POs/Sales Orders from 'Pending' -> 'Processing' -> 'Completed'.
inbound_outbound.cards: Dense cards showing PO/SO Number, items count, timestamp, and destination/source.

warehouse_storage.layout: Visual grid heatmap. A grid of small square divs representing bins/racks.
warehouse_storage.styling: Occupancy heatmap: Empty = border-white/10 bg-transparent, Partial = bg-amber-500/50, Full = bg-emerald-500/80, Over capacity = bg-red-500/80.

reports_analytics.layout: Top: AI-powered Insights Summary block (highlighted with a subtle amber glow). Below: Grid of Recharts.
reports_analytics.ai_insights: Use a text-typing effect or a stylized 'terminal' readout for AI summaries (e.g., 'System analysis: 3 SKUs require immediate reorder...')

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All interactive elements must change background or border color. Use transition-all duration-200.
motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Subtle fade in (opacity 0 to 1) for main content area when switching sidebar links.
motion_and_interactions.data_loading: Use a monospace 'Scanning...' text animation or a thin amber progress bar at the top of the container, instead of a standard generic spinner.

testing_guidelines.attributes: Add data-testid to EVERY button, link, form input, metric value, and table row.

login_background.description: Abstract glowing lines seen through a perforated surface. Use as the left-side background for the login screen.

empty_state_box.description: A rack of boxes in a large warehouse. Use as a background or visual asset for 'No Orders' or 'Warehouse Storage' empty states.

general_warehouse.description: A well-organized warehouse aisle with stacks of goods. Can be used in the About/Profile sections or top header banner if needed.

icons.rationale: Phosphor Icons provide a dense, technical look suitable for dashboards and developer tools. Install using: yarn add @phosphor-icons/react

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette. DO NOT inject generic Tailwind blue, indigo, or purple.
Use Phosphor icons for all iconography.
Build the dashboard using a fixed left sidebar and a main content area. Add padding (p-6) to the main content.
For tables, customize the Shadcn Table component to remove rounded corners (use rounded-sm) and apply the dense border-white/5 styling.
For the barcode feature, you can use a library like 'react-barcode' or simulate it visually with inline SVGs/monospaced fonts.
Implement realistic demo data for SKUs (e.g., 'SKU-8942-A'), Locations (e.g., 'Zone A-R4-B12'), and Transactions.
Ensure all fonts are imported via Google Fonts (IBM Plex Sans, JetBrains Mono) in index.html or global CSS.
Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements as specified in testing_guidelines.
